doc: The base of every findings case: a Service, an SLO with an inline SLI and one objective, the alert policy it names, that policy's condition and notification target. Every reference names a document of the stream, so the definition reports nothing; each findings-* case changes this stream in one place. The findings are the definition's (openslo-slo.dis, constraints), stated with their element and severity for a host to replay; FBL itself reports nothing on this stream, and the validator's reading check compares the elements.
